name: Scim
description: Scim capabilities. Includes Create a new user in the organization (requires organization-scoped API key), Get a specific user by ID (requires organization-scoped API key), Get SCIM Resource Types (requires organization-scoped API key), Get SCIM Schemas (requires organization-scoped API key), Get SCIM Service Provider Configuration (requires organization-scoped API key), List users in the organization (requires organization-scoped API key), Remove a user from the organization (requires organization-scoped API key).
